title: Libra Weighs the Leftover Confetti
skyStory: The moon is perfectly full today, one hundred percent, and has drifted into Libra, the sign of the scales. It is weighing what is left from yesterday's party: confetti on one side, gratitude on the other. Gratitude wins easily. Venus, Libra's ruler, sweeps up the glitter and hums. Saturn is having a second slice of the lopsided cake and denying it.

reading: The day after a birthday is a soft landing. The confetti has settled, the messages have slowed, and the cabin is quiet in that satisfied, post-party way. Do not rush back into ten projects. The full moon asks for one more day of glow.

Reread the birthday messages you received. Slowly. Out loud if you are alone. The [[Six of Pentacles]] wants you to notice how much people wanted to give to you, and how good it feels to have received it. Write down the one line that made you grin the hardest and tape it inside a cupboard door. Future-you will open that cupboard on a grey Tuesday and be delighted.
joel.mission: Tape your favourite line from a birthday message inside a cupboard door where you will find it again in a month.
joel.omen: A stray piece of glitter or confetti somewhere it has no business being. It means the celebration is still quietly going on.

reading: You gave a lot yesterday: thought, time, words chosen with care. Today Libra brings the scales back into balance, and it is your turn to rest. The shore is still and silver under the full moon, and the tide has nowhere it needs to be.

Take an hour today that belongs entirely to you. No helping. No levelling anyone up. Just you and something you love, a book, a walk, a hot drink by a window. The Wood Rat curls up in a pile of soft things and closes her eyes, deeply content. The full moon is watching over the shore, keeping the light on so you can rest.
nancy.mission: Claim one full hour today for doing absolutely nothing useful, and defend it like a castle wall.
nancy.omen: The full moon reflected in still water or a window. It means everything is balanced, and you have earned a rest.

together.text: Post-party rest day. Each of you name one tiny, perfect moment from the birthday weekend and send it to the other in a single sentence. Then both of you take the evening off from being useful. Libra insists, and Venus brought blankets.
